ayahs.1: Alif-Lam-Mim — letters opening a surah about trial and trust.
ayahs.2: Do people imagine that saying We believe will leave them untested?
ayahs.3: We tested those before them, and Allah will surely distinguish the truthful from the liars.
ayahs.4: Do the wrongdoers think they will escape Us? How corrupt is their judgment.
ayahs.5: Whoever hopes for meeting Allah — know that Allah's appointed term is coming. He is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
ayahs.6: Whoever strives — in jihad, struggle in Allah's cause by context — does so for their own soul's good. Allah has no need of creation.
ayahs.7: Those who believe and do good — We will absolve their sins and reward them for the best of what they used to do.
ayahs.8: We commanded people to honour parents. If they urge you to associate with Me what you have no knowledge of, do not obey them. To Me you will all return, and I will inform you of what you did.
ayahs.9: Those who believe and do good will be admitted among the righteous.
ayahs.10: Some say, We believe in Allah, yet when they suffer for Allah's cause they treat people's persecution as Allah's punishment. When victory comes from your Rabb, they say to believers, We were always with you. Does Allah not know best what is in every heart?
ayahs.11: Allah will distinguish those of sure iman from those of nifaq — outward acceptance with inward rejection.
ayahs.12: Those who reject the truth tell believers: Follow our way and we will carry your sins. They would never carry any of believers' sins. They lie.
ayahs.13: They will carry their own burdens and others' burdens with them, and on Judgment Day they will be questioned about what they fabricated.
ayahs.14: We sent Noah to his people and he remained among them a thousand years less fifty. The Flood seized them while they persisted in wrong.
ayahs.15: We saved him and those in the Ark, making it a sign for all peoples.
ayahs.16: Abraham said to his people: Worship Allah and live with taqwa toward Him. That is better for you, if you knew.
ayahs.17: You worship besides Allah only idols you invent. What you worship besides Allah cannot provide for you. Seek provision from Allah, worship Him, and show shukr. To Him you will all return.
ayahs.18: If you persist in denial, so did communities before you. The messenger's duty is only clear delivery.
ayahs.19: Have they not seen how Allah originates creation then resurrects it? That is easy for Allah.
ayahs.20: Say, O Prophet: Travel the land and see how He originated creation. Then Allah will produce it again. He is Most Capable of everything.
ayahs.21: He punishes whom He wills and shows mercy to whom He wills. To Him you will all be returned.
ayahs.22: You cannot escape Him on earth or in heaven. You have no protector or helper besides Allah.
ayahs.23: Those who reject Allah's signs and meeting Him — they have no hope in His mercy and will suffer painful punishment.
ayahs.24: Abraham's people only said: Kill him or burn him. Allah saved him from the fire. In that are signs for those who trust.
ayahs.25: He told them: You took idols instead of Allah only to preserve worldly harmony among yourselves. On Judgment Day you will disown and curse one another. Your home is the Fire, and you have no helper.
ayahs.26: Lot believed in him. Abraham said: I am emigrating to my Rabb. He alone is the Almighty, All-Wise.
ayahs.27: We blessed him with Isaac and Jacob, and placed prophethood and revelation among his descendants. We gave him his reward in this dunya, and in the Akhirah he is among the righteous.
ayahs.28: Lot rebuked his people: You commit a shameful deed no one before you did.
ayahs.29: Do you lust after men, abuse travellers, and commit open immorality in your gatherings? They answered mockingly: Bring Allah's punishment if you speak truth.
ayahs.30: Lot prayed: My Rabb, help me against the people of corruption.
ayahs.31: When Our messenger-angels came to Abraham with good news, they said: We are going to destroy the people of this city, for they persist in wrong.
ayahs.32: He said: But Lot is there. They replied: We know who is there. We will save him and his family except his wife, who is among the doomed.
ayahs.33: When Our messenger-angels came to Lot, he was distressed by their arrival. They said: Do not fear or grieve. We will save you and your family except your wife among the doomed.
ayahs.34: We are bringing down punishment from heaven on the people of this city for their rebellion.
ayahs.35: We left some of its ruins as a clear lesson for people of understanding.
ayahs.36: To Midian We sent their brother Shu'ayb. He said: O my people, worship Allah and hope for the Last Day. Do not spread corruption in the land.
ayahs.37: They rejected him, so an overwhelming earthquake seized them and they fell lifeless in their homes.
ayahs.38: The peoples of 'Ad and Thamud met a similar fate — clear to you from their ruins. Satan made their deeds seem fair, blocking them from the path though they could reason.
ayahs.39: We also destroyed Korah, Pharaoh, and Haman. Moses came to them with clear proofs, yet they acted arrogantly in the land and could not escape Us.
ayahs.40: We seized each for their sin: some by stones from the sky, some by blast, some swallowed by earth, some drowned. Allah did not wrong them; they wronged themselves.
ayahs.41: Those who take protectors besides Allah are like a spider spinning a shelter — the flimsiest of shelters, if they knew.
ayahs.42: Allah knows that whatever they invoke besides Him is nothing. He is the Almighty, All-Wise.
ayahs.43: These are parables We set for people, but none grasp them except people of knowledge.
ayahs.44: Allah created the heavens and the earth for a purpose. In that is a sign for people of iman.
ayahs.45: Recite what was revealed to you of the Book and establish salah. Genuine salah should restrain from indecency and wrong; dhikr — conscious remembrance of Allah — is even greater. Allah knows what you do.
ayahs.46: Do not argue with the People of the Book except in the best manner, except those who wrong among them. Say: We believe in what was revealed to us and to you. Our Rabb and your Rabb is One, and to Him we submit.
ayahs.47: We revealed to you a Book as We did to earlier messengers. Those We gave Scripture believe in it, as do some of these Arabs. None rejects Our ayahs except those who stubbornly reject the truth.
ayahs.48: You could not read any writing before this, nor write — otherwise people of falsehood would suspect.
ayahs.49: Rather, these are clear ayahs preserved in the hearts of those gifted with knowledge. None rejects them except wrongdoers.
ayahs.50: They say: If only signs came from his Rabb! Say, O Prophet: Signs are with Allah. I am sent only with clear warning.
ayahs.51: Is it not enough that We sent down to you a Book recited to them? In it is mercy and reminder for people who believe.
ayahs.52: Say, O Prophet: Sufficient is Allah as Witness between me and you. He knows whatever is in the heavens and earth. Those who believe falsehood and reject Allah — they are the true losers.
ayahs.53: They challenge you to hasten punishment. Had a term not been set, it would have come at once. It will take them by surprise when they least expect.
ayahs.54: They urge you to hasten punishment. Hell will encompass those who rejected the truth
ayahs.55: on the Day punishment overwhelms them from above and below their feet. It will be said: Taste what you sowed.
ayahs.56: O My believing servants, My earth is spacious — so worship Me alone.
ayahs.57: Every soul will taste death. Then to Us you will all be returned.
ayahs.58: Those who believe and do good — We will house them in elevated mansions in Paradise with rivers flowing beneath, to remain forever. How excellent is the reward of those who work righteousness —
ayahs.59: those who bear sabr and put trust in their Rabb.
ayahs.60: How many creatures cannot secure their provision! Allah provides for them and for you. He is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
ayahs.61: If you ask them who created the heavens and earth and subjected sun and moon, they will say, Allah. How then are they deluded?
ayahs.62: Allah gives abundant or limited provision to whom He wills among His servants. He has full knowledge of everything.
ayahs.63: If you ask them who sends rain from the sky, reviving earth after death, they will say, Allah. Say: Praise belongs to Allah — yet most do not understand.
ayahs.64: This dunya is only play and diversion. The Akhirah is the real life, if only they knew.
ayahs.65: If they are aboard a ship in storm, they call to Allah with sincere devotion. Once delivered to shore, they associate others with Him again.
ayahs.66: Let them be ungrateful for what We gave and enjoy awhile — soon they will know.
ayahs.67: Have they not seen how We made Mecca a secure sanctuary while people around them are snatched away? How can they believe falsehood and deny Allah's favours?
ayahs.68: Who does greater wrong than one who fabricates lies against Allah or rejects truth after it reached them? Is Hell not a fitting home for those who rejected the truth?
ayahs.69: Those who struggle in Our cause — We will guide them on Our ways. Allah is with those who do good.
